hero.eyebrow: Born In the USA · Raised in Penang · Based in Kuala Lumpur · Publishing since 1995
hero.lede: A writer, apologist, SEO specialist and developer, working on scholarly resources for Muslim apologetics and building tools that keep the web open and honest.
hero.tagline: SEO specialist by day, Muslim apologist by night.

about.standfirst: Born in San José, California and raised in Penang, I have spent the last three decades oscillating between two disciplines that look nothing alike on paper: ==search engines== and ==scripture==.
paragraphs: I studied Computing with a specialism in Internet Technologies at the Asia Pacific Institute of Information Technology, after sitting my NSW-HSC at International College, Penang. I went straight into the web, running my own boutique SEO sub-contracting agency from 2006 until 2015. I now work in-house as an SEO specialist for a digital marketing agency based in Europe, remotely from Kuala Lumpur.

Since 1999 the rest of my attention has gone to the study of comparative religion, covering Judaism, Christianity and Islam, under the pen name *Ibn Juferi al-Amriki*. I am a co-founder and executive editor of *Bismika Allahuma*, a long-running archive of Muslim responses to anti-Islam polemics.

Creative writing came first. I have been published since 1995 in *Dewan Sastera*, *Dewan Siswa*, *Pelita Bahasa* and *Karya*, and won the Hadiah Sastera Siswa Bank Rakyat poetry prize twice, in 1997 and again in 1998/99, after taking part in Dewan Bahasa dan Pustaka's Minggu Penulis Remaja mentorship in 1996.
Off the clock: Total War: Warhammer, Liverpool FC and Selangor FA, a growing interest in photography, and an unshakeable loyalty to Penang's nasi kandar and pasembur.
